title: Switch to LIVE and back
caption: Mirrors tools/e2e/specs/ota-admin/live-environment.e2e.ts. Needs a live OTA (go-live in the portal); live OTAs require MFA on the portal account.

steps.title: Open the console of a live OTA
steps.expect: TEST, with a TEST / LIVE switch (owner, admin, agent, finance).

steps.title: Switch to LIVE
steps.expect: Dashboard `/` of LIVE; amber shell with "LIVE environment"; only live bookings listed; a test booking's URL answers "Booking not found" naming LIVE.

steps.title: Open a destructive dialog
steps.body: Open **Cancel the booking** on a live booking, do not confirm.
steps.expect: The environment badge, the live warning and "… in LIVE" on the button.

steps.title: As a viewer
steps.expect: TEST badge only, no switch; forcing the cookie to `live` shows "Live is not available for this OTA or role" and falls back to test.

steps.title: Billing notice
steps.body: With the OTA `past_due` or `trial_ending` (set by the platform).
steps.expect: Every role sees the notice; owner and finance get "Go to billing in the portal", the others "The OTA's owners and finance staff manage billing in the portal."
